subject: System Design
title: How WhatsApp Served 2 Billion with 50 Engineers
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on How WhatsApp Served 2 Billion with 50 Engineers.

hook.text: WhatsApp served 900 million users with just 50 engineers. Most companies need 10x more.

buildup.text: They chose Erlang, a language built for telecom systems that handles millions of concurrent connections.

discovery.text: Each server handled 2 million connections. Erlang's lightweight processes made this possible.

twist.text: WhatsApp kept their architecture simple: no microservices, no Kubernetes, no trendy tools.

climax.text: Simplicity was their superpower. Fewer moving parts meant fewer failures and a smaller team.

punchline.text: The right tool and simplicity beat complexity.

quiz.question: Why could WhatsApp operate with so few engineers?
options: They chose simple architecture and the right technology
